Standard: Crew station controls (e.g., manual on-off-start and emergency shutdown, and ram air turbine deployment) are provided to allow the flight crew to configure the APS and emergency power system to maintain SCFs across the design envelope. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review drawings, flight crew interfaces, and flight manual(s) to verify APS and emergency power system crew station controls have been provided. Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct on air vehicle demonstration of APS and emergency power system controls under both normal system operation and with simulated failures to verify that APS and emergency power system controls function as designed. Test.
    (1) Flight test: Conduct flight testing or air vehicle simulations to verify that APS and emergency power system controls function as designed.
